requiredComponents.specCitation: HL7au:00044.1.2 (r2) — CX <assigning authority (HD)> component must be valued and must conform to sub points of HL7au:00044.2.
HL7au:00044.1.3 — CX <identifier type code (ID)> component must be valued with a valid value from HL7 Table 0203 - Identifier type.

_skipped.HL7au:00044.1.1: CX-1 (ID) must be specified — redundant with base spec (CX.requiredComponents already requires CX-1).
_skipped.HL7au:00044.1.2_NASH_subpoints: The HL7au:00044.2 sub-points referenced are NASH/PKI runtime-dependent rules out of scope for parser/validator.
_skipped.HL7au:00044.1.3_value_set: The 'valid value from HL7 Table 0203' clause is value-set validation deferred to S5-C.

pairRules.specCitation: HL7au:00044.4.1 — When an <identifier (ST)> component is specified, the <name of the coding system> must also be specified.
HL7au:00044.4.2 — If no <identifier (ST)> component is specified then no <name of coding system> (primary coding system) must be specified.
HL7au:00044.4.5 — When an <alternate identifier (ST)> component is specified, the <name of alternate coding system> must also be specified.
HL7au:00044.4.6 — If no <alternate identifier (ST)> component is specified then no <name of alternate coding system> must be specified.
HL7au:00044.5.1 — identifier set ⇒ name of coding system set
HL7au:00044.5.2 — identifier empty ⇒ name of coding system empty
HL7au:00044.5.5 — alt identifier set ⇒ alt name of coding system set
HL7au:00044.5.6 — alt identifier empty ⇒ alt name of coding system empty
HL7au:00044.6.1 — When an <identifier (ST)> component is specified, the <name of the coding system> must also be specified.
HL7au:00044.6.2 — If no <identifier (ST)> component is specified then no <name of coding system> must be specified.
HL7au:00044.6.4 — When an <alternate identifier (ST)> component is specified, the <name of alternate coding system> must also be specified.
HL7au:00044.6.5 — If no <alternate identifier (ST)> component is specified then no <name of alternate coding system> must be specified.
